plan.tagline: Automate overdue invoice reminders for freelancers and small businesses.
plan.problem: Freelancers and small businesses waste hours manually chasing late payments, hurting cash flow and productivity.
plan.solution: CLI tool that tracks invoices, sends automated polite reminders, and generates reports—all offline with optional email/SMS alerts.
plan.target_market: Indie hackers, developers, and small business owners who bill clients and need to automate payment follow-ups.
mvp_features: Offline demo mode with hardcoded data
plan.demo_script: Run `invoicechase --demo` to see 3 sample invoices (1 overdue), generate a report, and simulate sending a reminder—all without internet.
plan.phuket_angle: Perfect for Phuket-based freelancers/cafes who serve tourists—automate chasing payments from foreign clients while they enjoy the islands.
